Welcome to Episode 5 of our incredible Jharkhand travel series! We went deep into Ghatshila to document a disappearing part of rural India’s tribal culture: the unique, traditional village life, and the making and sharing of an incredibly potent Ancient Fermented Drink. See the entire process and how this unique local cuisine shapes the community here!
This powerful Traditional Drink is more than just a beverage—it’s a part of the history and culture of the tribal community. Watch as we share a glimpse into a way of life rarely seen by outsiders.
